description: Look up a US tax-exempt organization by exact EIN from the IRS Exempt Organizations Business Master File (~1.27M orgs). Returns name, address, IRC subsection, and current EO status. Use nonprofit_details for the fully decoded record.

ein.description: Employer Identification Number (EIN). Accepts 9 digits with or without a dash, e.g. "13-1837418" or "131837418".

name: nonprofit_lookup_ein
